recipe.title: Lebanese Kibbeh
recipe.description: Fried bulgur and lamb shells stuffed with spiced meat, onions and pine nuts.

ingredients.item: fine bulgur, soaked 15 minutes and squeezed
very lean ground lamb or beef, for the shell

steps: Process the bulgur, lean meat, grated onion, half the spices and salt into a smooth paste, using ice water if needed.
For the filling, brown the ground lamb with the chopped onion, pine nuts and remaining spices.
Shape a ball of shell mix, hollow it with your finger, fill and seal into an oval.
Fry at 350°F for 5 to 6 minutes until deep brown and cooked through (160°F). Serve with yogurt.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Left Hand
recipe.description: A bourbon Negroni variation with chocolate bitters.

ingredients.item: vegan sweet vermouth (such as Dolin Rouge)

steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Lemon Caper Chickpea Pasta
recipe.description: Spaghetti, chickpeas and capers tossed in a glossy lemon-garlic olive-oil sauce, without cream or cheese.

ingredients.item: salt, plus water for boiling pasta

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season lightly with salt. Cook spaghetti according to its package until just tender. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile warm oil in a wide skillet over medium-low heat. Cook garlic for 1 minute without browning. Add chickpeas and capers and heat for 3 minutes.
Add drained spaghetti, lemon zest, half the lemon juice and 1/2 cup reserved pasta water. Toss over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy, adding more pasta water if dry.
Fold in parsley and black pepper. Taste and add the remaining lemon juice and up to 1/2 tsp salt as needed; capers are salty.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Starchy pasta water helps the olive oil coat the spaghetti. Taste before adding extra salt.
recipe.make_ahead: Refrigerate promptly for up to 3 days. Reheat gently with a splash of water until steaming throughout.

recipe.title: Lemon Chickpea Couscous Salad
recipe.description: Couscous and chickpeas tossed with cucumber, parsley and a lemon dressing.
steps: Put couscous in a bowl, pour over boiling water, cover and rest 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and cool slightly.
Whisk oil, lemon zest and juice, salt and pepper. Toss with couscous, chickpeas, cucumber and parsley.
Serve immediately or refrigerate in a covered container.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Lemon Drop
recipe.description: Vodka, lemon and orange liqueur in a sugar-rimmed glass.
steps: Rim a martini glass with sugar.
Shake everything with ice and strain into the glass.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lemon and syrup and top with sparkling lemonade in a sugar-rimmed glass.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Lemon Garlic Turkey Meatballs and Bulgur
recipe.description: Baked turkey meatballs over bulgur with lemon, garlic and parsley.
steps: Heat oven to 425 F (220 C). Mix turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, half the garlic, lemon zest, half the parsley, half the salt and pepper. Form 16 equal meatballs.
Brush a lined sheet pan with 1 tbsp oil, add meatballs and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until every center reaches 165 F (74 C).
Meanwhile simmer bulgur with 2 cups water and remaining salt for 12 to 15 minutes, or its package time; rest covered for 5 minutes.
Warm remaining oil and garlic for 30 seconds in a small pan, add sauce water and lemon juice and simmer for 1 minute. Spoon over meatballs and bulgur and add remaining parsley.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Bulgur is wheat. Check breadcrumbs for additional milk, soy or sesame ingredients.
recipe.make_ahead: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 3 days. Reheat leftovers to 165 F (74 C).

recipe.title: Lemon-Oregano Chicken and Potatoes
recipe.description: Crisp-skinned chicken thighs roasted on a bed of garlicky potatoes with lemon and oregano. One pan, and the juices season everything.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with half the oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Spread in a roasting pan.
Rub chicken with remaining oil, lemon zest, salt and pepper; place skin-side up among potatoes. Roast 35–45 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potatoes are tender. Turn potatoes once.
Rest chicken 5 minutes. Spoon lemon juice over the pan before serving.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Lemony Orzo with Roasted Broccoli and Walnuts
recipe.description: Lemon-dressed orzo with browned broccoli, garlic and toasted walnuts.
steps: Heat oven to 425 F (220 C). Toss broccoli with 1 tbsp oil and half the salt. Roast for 18 to 22 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned.
Cook orzo according to the package. Reserve 1/2 cup cooking water and drain. Toast walnuts in a dry skillet over medium-low heat for 3 minutes; set aside.
Warm remaining oil with garlic for 30 seconds. Toss in orzo, lemon zest and juice, pepper, remaining salt and enough reserved water to coat the pasta lightly.
Fold in roasted broccoli, walnuts and parsley.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Orzo is wheat pasta, not rice. This recipe intentionally contains walnuts and has no cheese.
recipe.make_ahead: Refrigerate promptly in shallow containers for up to 3 days. Reheat leftovers to 165 F (74 C).

recipe.title: Lion's Tail
recipe.description: Bourbon with allspice dram, lime and bitters.
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Chicken Lo Mein
recipe.description: Soft egg noodles stir-fried with chicken and vegetables in a savory soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles as the package directs, drain and rinse.
Mix the soy sauces, oyster sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until cooked through (165°F), then add the garlic, cabbage and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, sauce and green onions and toss for 2 minutes until coated and hot.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Loaded Baked Potato
recipe.description: Crisp-skinned baked potatoes loaded with butter, cheese, bacon, sour cream and chives.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Scrub and dry the potatoes, prick them, rub with oil and salt.
Bake directly on the rack for 50 to 60 minutes until tender.
Split open, fluff the insides and add butter.
Top with cheese and return to the oven for 3 minutes to melt.
Finish with bacon, sour cream and chives.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Maine Lobster Roll
recipe.description: The New England summer classic: big chunks of chilled lobster lightly dressed with mayonnaise, lemon and celery, piled into a buttery toasted split-top bun.

ingredients.item: cooked lobster meat, cut into large chunks
split-top New England-style hot dog buns

steps: Gently fold the lobster with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, celery, chives, salt and pepper. Chill while you toast the buns.
Spread the flat outer sides of the buns with the butter.
Toast the buns in a skillet over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until golden.
Line each bun with a lettuce leaf, if using, and pile in the lobster. Serve right away.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Go light on the mayonnaise. It should coat the lobster, not drown it.
Split-top buns have flat sides that toast evenly. Regular hot dog buns work in a pinch.
One 1 1/2-lb lobster gives roughly 1/3 lb of meat.
variations: Connecticut-style: skip the mayonnaise and celery and toss the lobster in 4 tbsp warm melted butter with a squeeze of lemon instead.

recipe.title: Lomo Saltado
recipe.description: Peruvian stir-fried beef with onions, tomatoes and soy, served with fries and rice.

ingredients.item: aji amarillo or yellow chile, sliced

steps: Season the beef and sear in a very hot wok in batches. Remove.
Stir-fry the onion and chile for 1 minute, then the garlic.
Return the beef, add the soy sauce and vinegar, then the tomatoes for 30 seconds.
Toss with cilantro and the fries and serve with rice.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: London Calling

ingredients.item: vegan fino sherry (such as Tio Pepe)

steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Long Island Iced Tea
recipe.description: Five white spirits with lemon and a splash of cola. Strong despite the name.
steps: Shake everything except the cola with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled highball and top with cola.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Iced black tea with lemon, a little syrup and a splash of cola.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Lucien Gaudin

ingredients.item: vegan dry vermouth (such as Dolin Dry)

steps: Stir everything with ice.

recipe.title: Lychee Lime Gin Fizz
recipe.description: Lychee juice and lime give a light gin fizz a delicate floral sweetness.
steps: Shake gin, lychee juice and lime with ice for 12 seconds.
Strain into an ice-filled highball glass and top with soda.
Stir gently and add one lychee on a cocktail pick.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake 3 oz lychee juice and 3/4 oz lime juice with ice; strain over fresh ice and top with 3 oz soda.

recipe.note: An original Relish home cocktail. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Use lychee juice, not the much sweeter syrup from a can; if using syrup, dilute it and taste first.

recipe.title: Lynchburg Lemonade
recipe.description: A Tennessee favorite: Tennessee whiskey, triple sec and fresh lemon, topped with lemon-lime soda over ice. Sweet, tangy and easy-drinking.
steps: Shake the whiskey, triple sec, lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into a tall glass filled with ice.
Top with the lemon-lime soda, stir gently and garnish with a lemon wheel.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lemon juice and syrup, then top with lemon-lime soda over ice.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Fresh lemon juice beats bottled sour mix every time.
Add the soda last and stir gently to keep the bubbles.
variations: Make a pitcher: multiply by 8 and top with soda just before serving.

recipe.title: M&M
recipe.description: Equal parts Maker's Mark bourbon and Montenegro amaro, stirred.
steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain over a large cube in a rocks glass.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Baked Macaroni and Cheese
recipe.description: Creamy cheddar macaroni baked under a crunchy buttered breadcrumb top.

ingredients.item: panko breadcrumbs mixed with 1 tbsp melted butter

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the macaroni 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in 3 cups cheese, the mustard and salt until smooth.
Fold in the macaroni, pour into a baking dish and top with the remaining cheese and the breadcrumbs.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Macaroni Salad
recipe.description: Creamy, tangy cold elbow macaroni salad with celery, onion and peppers.
steps: Cook the macaroni, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard and sugar.
Toss with the pasta, celery, onion, pepper and eggs. Season.
Chill at least 1 hour and sprinkle with paprika.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Madras
recipe.description: A bright, easygoing highball: vodka over ice with cranberry juice and orange juice. Sweet-tart and pretty in red and orange.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice and add the vodka and cranberry juice.
Pour the orange juice over the top for a sunset effect, or stir to blend.
Garnish with an orange slice.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Mix cranberry and orange juice over ice with a squeeze of lime.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Pour the orange juice last and gently for a layered look.
variations: Bay Breeze: use pineapple juice instead of orange juice.
Sea Breeze: use grapefruit juice instead of orange juice.

recipe.title: Mai Tai
recipe.description: Aged rum with lime, orange curaçao and almond orgeat, the tiki classic.
steps: Shake everything with crushed ice.
Pour unstrained into a double rocks glass and top with more crushed ice.

cocktail.garnish: spent lime shell and mint sprig
cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lime, orange juice, orgeat and pineapple juice with crushed ice.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Char Kway Teow
recipe.description: Smoky stir-fried flat rice noodles with shrimp, Chinese sausage, egg and bean sprouts.
steps: Mix the soy sauces, oyster sauce and chili paste.
Heat a wok very hot, fry the garlic, shrimp and sausage 1 minute.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss to char.
Push aside, scramble the eggs and mix in.
Toss in the sprouts and chives for 30 seconds.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Mamacita
recipe.description: Tequila and passion fruit with lime and a splash of soda.
steps: Shake everything except the soda with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled glass and top with soda.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Passion fruit, lime and agave topped with grapefruit soda (such as Jarritos Toronja).

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Man O' War
recipe.description: Bourbon, orange curaçao, sweet vermouth and lemon.

ingredients.item: vegan sweet vermouth (such as Dolin Rouge)

steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mango Chile Margarita
recipe.description: A mango margarita with a gentle chile kick from tequila, lime and orange liqueur.
steps: Shake tequila, mango, lime, orange liqueur and agave with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled rocks glass and dust lightly with chile.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: substitute alcohol-free tequila and orange alternatives, or use orange juice for the liqueur.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mango Coconut Rum Sour
recipe.description: Coconut rum with mango and lime, served over ice.
steps: Shake rum, mango, lime and syrup with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice and garnish with lime.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake the mango, lime and syrup with 1 oz coconut water and ice, and strain over ice.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mango Lime Brandy Punch
recipe.description: Brandy, mango nectar and lime make a short tropical fruit punch.
steps: Shake brandy, mango nectar, lime and syrup with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
Add the mango slice and serve immediately.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake 3 oz mango nectar, 3/4 oz lime juice and 1/4 oz syrup with ice; strain over fresh ice.

recipe.note: An original Relish home cocktail. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Taste the mango nectar first; reduce the syrup if it is already heavily sweetened.
recipe.make_ahead: Prepare to order. Keep juices and brewed teas refrigerated until needed.

recipe.title: Mango Tamarind Tequila Sour
recipe.description: Mango nectar and unsweetened tamarind sharpen a round tequila sour.
steps: Whisk tamarind paste into mango nectar in a shaker until smooth.
Add tequila, lime juice, agave syrup and ice. Shake for 15 seconds.
Fine-strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice and garnish with the lime wheel.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Whisk tamarind into 3 oz mango nectar; shake with 1/2 oz lime juice, 1/4 oz agave and ice, then strain over ice.

recipe.note: An original Relish home cocktail. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Choose culinary unsweetened tamarind paste rather than a sweetened chutney. Thin very concentrated paste with water before measuring.
recipe.make_ahead: Prepare to order. Keep juices and brewed teas refrigerated until needed.

recipe.title: Mangú con los Tres Golpes
recipe.description: The Dominican Republic's favorite breakfast: buttery mashed green plantains topped with vinegary red onions, served with the "three hits": fried salami, fried cheese and fried eggs.

ingredients.item: green (unripe) plantains, peeled and cut in chunks
cold water, from the plantain pot
large red onion, sliced into rings
queso de freír (frying cheese), sliced 1/2 inch thick

steps: Boil the plantains in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until very tender.
Meanwhile, cook the onion rings in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook 2 minutes more, until just softened and tangy.
Drain the plantains, keeping some of the water. Mash them with the butter, adding cold water a little at a time, until smooth and creamy.
Fry the salami slices in a little oil for 2 minutes a side until crisp at the edges. Fry the cheese in the same pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Pile the mangú on plates, top with the onions and their juices, and serve with the salami, cheese, eggs and avocado.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Mash the plantains while they're hot and add the water cold. Dominican cooks swear it makes the mangú extra smooth.
Use fully green plantains; ripe ones make a sweet, different dish.
Pat the cheese dry before frying so it browns instead of spattering.
Sunny-side-up eggs have runny yolks. For anyone pregnant, older or with a weakened immune system, cook them until firm or use pasteurized eggs.
recipe.make_ahead: Mangú stiffens as it cools; reheat with a splash of water and stir until smooth.
variations: Use queso blanco or halloumi if you can't find queso de freír.

cold water, from the plantain pot
large red onion, sliced into rings
portobello mushrooms, sliced thick and seasoned with smoked paprika
queso de freír (frying cheese), sliced 1/2 inch thick

Meanwhile, cook the onion rings in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook 2 minutes more, until just softened and tangy.

Fry the mushroom slices in a little oil for 3 minutes a side until browned. Fry the cheese in the same pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Pile the mangú on plates, top with the onions and their juices, and serve with the mushrooms, cheese, eggs and avocado.
vegetarian.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Mash the plantains while they're hot and add the water cold. Dominican cooks swear it makes the mangú extra smooth.
Use fully green plantains; ripe ones make a sweet, different dish.
Pat the cheese dry before frying so it browns instead of spattering.
Sunny-side-up eggs have runny yolks. For anyone pregnant, older or with a weakened immune system, cook them until firm or use pasteurized eggs.
vegetarian.make_ahead: Mangú stiffens as it cools; reheat with a splash of water and stir until smooth.

vegan.title: Vegan Mangú
vegan.description: Mashed green plantains made with olive oil, topped with tangy onions and served with smoky mushrooms, fried tofu and avocado.

ingredients.item: green (unripe) plantains, peeled and cut in chunks
cold water, from the plantain pot
large red onion, sliced into rings
portobello mushrooms, sliced thick and seasoned with smoked paprika
extra-firm tofu, pressed and sliced 1/2 inch thick

steps: Boil the plantains in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until very tender.
Meanwhile, cook the onion rings in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook 2 minutes more, until just softened and tangy.

Fry the ripe plantain slices for 2 minutes a side until caramelized.
Pile the mangú on plates, top with the onions and their juices, and serve with the mushrooms, tofu, sweet plantains and avocado.
vegan.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Mash the plantains while they're hot and add the water cold. Dominican cooks swear it makes the mangú extra smooth.

Pat the tofu dry before frying so it browns well.
Fry the ripe plantains over medium heat so they caramelize without burning.

recipe.title: Manhattan
recipe.description: Rye whiskey and sweet vermouth with bitters, stirred and served up.

ingredients.item: vegan sweet vermouth (such as Dolin Rouge)

steps: Stir everything with ice for 20 to 30 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Turkish Manti
recipe.description: Tiny beef dumplings topped with garlic yogurt and sizzling paprika butter.
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt into a firm dough. Rest 30 minutes.
Mix the meat, onion and salt.
Roll the dough thin, cut into 1 1/2-inch squares, add a pea-size piece of filling and pinch the corners together.
Boil the manti in salted water 10 to 12 minutes, until tender and the filling is cooked through (160°F).
Mix the yogurt and garlic. Melt the butter with the pepper and mint.
Spoon the garlic yogurt over the manti and drizzle with the hot butter.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Mantu (Afghan Dumplings)
recipe.description: Steamed dumplings filled with spiced beef and onion, served on cool garlic yogurt and topped with a warm tomato and split pea sauce and dried mint.

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling

steps: Mix the flour, salt and water into a firm dough. Knead 5 minutes, cover and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the beef, half the onion, coriander, pepper and salt for the filling.

Simmer the split peas in water for 30 minutes until tender, then drain. In the oil, soften the rest of the onion, add the garlic, tomato paste, tomato and paprika and a cup of water, then the split peas. Simmer 10 minutes into a thick sauce.
Roll the dough very thin and cut into 3 1/2-inch squares. Put a spoon of filling in each, bring two opposite corners together, then pinch the other two corners up to seal.
Steam the dumplings on oiled steamer racks for 25 to 30 minutes, until the filling is cooked and the wrappers are translucent.
Stir the grated garlic and a pinch of salt into the yogurt. Spread half on a platter, arrange the mantu on top, spoon over the tomato sauce and remaining yogurt, and finish with dried mint.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Roll the dough as thin as you can; thick wrappers turn doughy when steamed.
Raw onion in the filling releases juice as it steams, keeping the meat moist.
The cool yogurt, warm sauce and dried mint together are what make mantu, so don't skip any of them.
recipe.make_ahead: Freeze shaped, uncooked dumplings on a tray, then bag them; steam from frozen for 35 minutes. Both sauces keep 3 days.
variations: Shortcut: use store-bought round dumpling or wonton wrappers.

Steam the dumplings on oiled steamer racks for 25 to 30 minutes, until the wrappers are tender and translucent.
Stir the grated garlic and a pinch of salt into the yogurt. Spread half on a platter, arrange the mantu on top, spoon over the tomato sauce and remaining yogurt, and finish with dried mint.
vegetarian.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Roll the dough as thin as you can; thick wrappers turn doughy when steamed.
Cook the mushrooms until all their water is gone, or the filling will make the wrappers soggy.

recipe.title: Maple Dijon Salmon with Brussels Sprouts
recipe.description: Roasted salmon glazed with maple and mustard, served with browned Brussels sprouts.
steps: Heat oven to 425 F (220 C). Toss sprouts with oil, half the salt and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan cut-side down and roast for 15 minutes.
Whisk maple syrup, Dijon and lemon juice. Season salmon with remaining salt and brush with the glaze.
Move sprouts to the sides, add salmon and roast for 10 to 15 minutes, until fish reaches 145 F (63 C) and sprouts are tender.
Divide fish and sprouts among plates and spoon over the cooked pan juices.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Use a separate brush or spoon for raw fish; do not serve uncooked glaze that has touched it.
recipe.make_ahead: Refrigerate promptly and use within 2 days. Reheat leftovers to 165 F (74 C).

recipe.title: Classic Margarita
recipe.description: Bright and balanced: 100% agave tequila, fresh lime and orange liqueur, shaken hard and served over fresh ice with a half salt rim.

ingredients.item: agave syrup (1 part agave nectar to 1 part water), to taste

steps: Run the lime wedge around half the outside rim of a rocks glass and roll it in salt. Salting only the outside edge keeps salt from falling into the drink, and a half rim lets you choose each sip.
Fill the glass with fresh ice.
Add the tequila, lime, Cointreau and agave to a shaker and fill it with ice.
Shake hard for 10 to 12 seconds, until the shaker is very cold.
Strain over the fresh ice in the glass and garnish with the lime wheel.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake 2 oz lime juice, 1 oz orange juice and 1/2 oz agave syrup with ice and top with lime soda (such as Jarritos Lime) or grapefruit soda.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Check the label says 100% agave. Tequila without it (called mixto) can be up to 49% other sugars and tastes harsh.
Taste your limes: some are much more sour than others. Add the agave a little at a time until it tastes balanced.
Strain over fresh ice instead of pouring in the shaking ice. Shaking ice is broken up and melts fast, watering the drink down.
recipe.make_ahead: For a pitcher of 8: mix 2 cups tequila, 1 cup lime juice, 3/4 cup Cointreau, 1/4 cup agave syrup and 3/4 cup water. Chill at least 2 hours and pour over ice. Squeeze the lime the same day.
variations: Tommy's Margarita: skip the Cointreau and use 1/2 oz agave syrup for a cleaner, more tequila-forward drink.
Spicy: muddle 2 jalapeño slices in the shaker, or use a chili-salt rim (Tajín).
Frozen: blend all the ingredients with 1 cup ice until smooth.

recipe.title: Margherita Pizza
recipe.description: Neapolitan-style pizza with tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil.
steps: Heat the oven with a pizza stone or steel to 550°F for 45 minutes.
Season the tomatoes with salt.
Stretch half the dough into a 12-inch round, spread with tomato and top with mozzarella.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes until blistered. Drizzle with oil and top with basil. Repeat with the rest.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Martinez
recipe.description: Old Tom gin, sweet vermouth and maraschino, the ancestor of the Martini.

ingredients.item: vegan sweet vermouth (such as Dolin Rouge)

steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Dry Gin Martini
recipe.description: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred ice cold.

ingredients.item: vegan dry vermouth (such as Dolin Dry)

steps: Stir with ice for 30 seconds until very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mary Pickford
recipe.description: White rum, pineapple, maraschino and grenadine.
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Pineapple juice with grenadine and a cherry.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Masala Dosa
recipe.description: Thin, crisp South Indian rice and lentil crepes filled with spiced potatoes.

ingredients.item: dosa batter (fermented rice and urad dal)
salt, oil for the pan, coconut chutney and sambar

steps: Heat the oil, fry the mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves, then the onion and chiles until soft.
Add the turmeric, potatoes and salt and mix well.
Heat a griddle, spread a ladle of batter in a thin circle and drizzle with oil.
Cook until crisp and golden underneath, add a spoonful of potato filling and fold.
Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
recipe.description: Fluffy, buttery mashed potatoes with warm milk.

ingredients.item: Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut up

steps: Cover the potatoes with cold salted water, bring to a boil and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until very tender.
Drain and let steam dry for 2 minutes.
Mash with the butter, then stir in the warm milk and sour cream.
Season well and top with chives.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Massaman Curry
recipe.description: Mild, rich Thai curry of beef and potatoes with warm spices and peanuts.
steps: Fry the curry paste in a few spoonfuls of the thick coconut cream until fragrant.
Add the beef, the rest of the coconut milk, 1 cup water and the cinnamon. Simmer 1 hour.
Add the potatoes and onion and simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and tamarind, and stir in the peanuts. Serve with rice.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Classic Meatloaf
recipe.description: Tender beef meatloaf with a sweet, tangy ketchup glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the beef, onion, eggs, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf on a lined pan.
Mix the ketchup, sugar and vinegar and spread half over the loaf.
Bake 50 minutes, add the rest of the glaze and bake 10 minutes more, to 160°F inside. Rest 10 minutes.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Mediterranean Baked Feta Beans
recipe.description: Cannellini beans and tomatoes baked with feta, garlic and oregano.
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix beans, tomatoes, garlic, oil, oregano and pepper in a baking dish.
Nestle feta in the center. Bake 20–25 minutes until the beans bubble and the cheese is hot and lightly golden.
Break up the feta and spoon it over the beans. Taste before adding salt.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Birria
recipe.description: Chile-braised beef in a rich consommé, served as tacos with melted cheese for dipping.
steps: Toast the chiles and soak in hot water, then blend with the onion, garlic, tomatoes, vinegar and spices.
Season the beef, cover with the sauce and 6 cups water, add the bay leaves and simmer 3 to 3 1/2 hours until it shreds.
Shred the beef and skim the fat from the consommé.
Dip tortillas in the fat, fill with beef and cheese and griddle until crisp.
Serve with cups of consommé, onion, cilantro and lime.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Chiles en Nogada
recipe.description: Roasted poblanos stuffed with fruit-studded picadillo under creamy walnut sauce and pomegranate.

ingredients.item: a pinch each of sugar and salt, for the sauce

steps: Char the poblanos, steam in a bag, peel and slit open, removing the seeds.
Brown the meat with the onion, add the fruit, raisins, almonds and tomatoes and cook 15 minutes, until the meat is cooked through (160°F). Season.
Blend the walnuts, crema, cheese, milk and a pinch of sugar and salt into a smooth sauce.
Stuff the chiles with the picadillo.
Cover with walnut sauce and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds and parsley.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Mexican Firing Squad
recipe.description: Tequila, lime, grenadine and bitters, lengthened with soda.
steps: Shake everything except the soda with ice.
Strain over ice and top with soda.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Lime and grenadine topped with lime soda (such as Jarritos Lime).

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mezcal Negroni
recipe.description: A smoky Negroni made with mezcal.

ingredients.item: vegan sweet vermouth (such as Dolin Rouge)

steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain over a large cube in a rocks glass.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Miami Vice
recipe.description: Two frozen favorites in one glass: a frozen strawberry daiquiri swirled with a frozen piña colada. Fruity, creamy and very tropical.
steps: Blend 1 oz rum with the strawberries, lime juice, syrup and 1 cup ice until smooth. Pour into a jug and rinse the blender.
Blend the other 1 oz rum with the cream of coconut, pineapple juice and 1 cup ice until smooth.
Pour the two mixtures into a tall glass at the same time, from opposite sides, so they swirl together.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a strawberry.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Make both blends without rum and swirl them together.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Cream of coconut (sweetened, like Coco López) is not the same as coconut cream or coconut milk.
Keep each blend thick so they stay separate in the glass.
variations: Use dark rum in the piña colada half for a richer flavor.

recipe.title: Michelada
recipe.description: Mexican beer with lime, hot sauce and savory seasonings in a salted glass.

ingredients.item: gluten-free Worcestershire sauce (such as Lea & Perrins, US)
Tajín or chili salt, for the rim

steps: Rim a pint glass with chili salt and fill with ice.
Add the lime, sauces and juice, then top with beer.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Use non-alcoholic beer.

recipe.note: Contains barley (gluten) from the beer; Worcestershire usually contains anchovies.

recipe.title: Midori Sour
recipe.description: Bright green melon liqueur with lemon and lime.
steps: Shake everything except the soda with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled glass and top with soda.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Honeydew juice with lemon and lime, topped with lemon-lime soda.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Millionaire
recipe.description: Bourbon, orange curaçao and grenadine with egg white and absinthe.
steps: Dry-shake everything, then shake again with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.
tips: This drink uses raw egg white. Use pasteurized egg white if you prefer, and always for anyone pregnant, older or with a weakened immune system.

recipe.title: Mimosa
recipe.description: Chilled sparkling wine with orange juice.

ingredients.item: vegan sparkling wine (such as Moët & Chandon Impérial or Mionetto Organic Prosecco)

steps: Pour the sparkling wine into a flute.
Top gently with the orange juice.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Orange juice with sparkling water or alcohol-free sparkling wine.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mint Julep
recipe.description: Kentucky bourbon with mint and sugar over a mound of crushed ice.
steps: Gently press the mint and syrup in a julep cup.
Add the bourbon and fill with crushed ice. Stir until frosty.
Mound more crushed ice on top.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Mint, syrup and iced tea over crushed ice.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Miso-Glazed Eggplant Rice Bowls
recipe.description: Roasted eggplant with a savory miso glaze, served over rice and scallions.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Score eggplant flesh in a shallow crosshatch, brush with oil and roast cut-side up for 25–30 minutes until soft.
Stir miso, maple syrup, vinegar and water together. Brush over eggplant and return to the oven for 3–5 minutes, watching so the glaze does not burn.
Serve eggplant over hot rice, topped with scallions.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Miso Mushroom Soba Bowls
recipe.description: Soba noodles, browned mushrooms, edamame and carrot in a light miso-ginger glaze.

ingredients.item: soba noodles made with buckwheat and wheat
white miso made with rice and soybeans

steps: Cook soba according to the package, adding edamame for the last 3 minutes or its package cooking time. Drain and rinse briefly under cool water.
Whisk miso, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, ginger and water until smooth.
Heat neutral oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat. Brown mushrooms for 6 to 8 minutes. Add carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the miso mixture and simmer for 1 minute. Toss in soba and edamame and heat gently for 2 minutes. Finish with sesame oil, scallions and sesame seeds.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: This recipe intentionally uses wheat-containing soba; buckwheat in the name does not make soba wheat-free. Read miso and sauce labels.
recipe.make_ahead: Refrigerate promptly for up to 3 days. Loosen with water and reheat until steaming throughout.

recipe.title: Miso Soup
recipe.description: Japan's everyday soup: a light kombu and bonito broth with miso stirred in at the end, plus soft tofu, wakame seaweed and scallions.

ingredients.item: miso paste (white or red), plus more to taste
silken or soft tofu, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: Soak the kombu in the water in a saucepan for 30 minutes.
Heat the pan slowly over medium-low heat. Just before it boils, lift out the kombu.
Add the bonito flakes, bring just to a boil, then turn off the heat and let them steep for 2 minutes. Strain the broth (dashi) and return it to the pan.
Soak the wakame in a bowl of water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Warm the dashi over low heat. Put the miso in a ladle or small sieve, lower it into the broth and whisk until it dissolves.
Add the tofu and wakame and heat gently for 1 to 2 minutes. Do not let the soup boil.
Ladle into bowls and top with the scallions.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Never boil miso soup once the miso is in. Boiling dulls its aroma and flavor.
Start with 1 tablespoon of miso per cup of broth and add more to taste. Brands vary in saltiness.
recipe.make_ahead: Make the dashi up to 3 days ahead and keep it in the fridge. Add the miso and tofu just before serving.
variations: Add sliced mushrooms, spinach or cubes of daikon, cooking them in the dashi before the miso goes in.

vegetarian.title: Vegetarian Miso Soup
vegetarian.description: Japan's everyday miso soup made with a kombu and shiitake broth, plus soft tofu, wakame seaweed and scallions.

ingredients.item: miso paste (white or red), plus more to taste
silken or soft tofu, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: Soak the kombu and dried shiitake in the water in a saucepan for 30 minutes.
Heat the pan slowly over medium-low heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Lift out the kombu and mushrooms; slice the mushrooms and return them to the broth.
Soak the wakame in a bowl of water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Warm the broth over low heat. Put the miso in a ladle or small sieve, lower it into the broth and whisk until it dissolves.
Add the tofu and wakame and heat gently for 1 to 2 minutes. Do not let the soup boil.
Ladle into bowls and top with the scallions.
vegetarian.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Never boil miso soup once the miso is in. Boiling dulls its aroma and flavor.
Start with 1 tablespoon of miso per cup of broth and add more to taste. Brands vary in saltiness.
vegetarian.make_ahead: Make the kombu and shiitake broth up to 3 days ahead and keep it in the fridge. Add the miso and tofu just before serving.

recipe.title: Missionary's Downfall
recipe.description: Don the Beachcomber's frozen rum drink with mint, pineapple, honey and peach.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Pour into a chilled coupe or glass.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Blend without the rum and brandy, adding a splash of peach nectar.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

recipe.title: Mohinga (Burmese Fish Noodle Soup)
recipe.description: Myanmar's national breakfast: thin rice noodles in a thick, golden catfish broth fragrant with lemongrass, ginger and turmeric, thickened with toasted rice and chickpea flour. Topped with egg, fritters, lime and chili.

ingredients.item: lemongrass, bruised, plus 1 stalk finely chopped
rice flour, toasted in a dry pan until golden
chickpea flour, toasted in a dry pan until golden
small shallots, peeled and left whole
sliced banana stem or banana blossom (optional)
cilantro, lime wedges, chili flakes, fried onions and split pea fritters, to serve

steps: Simmer the catfish in the water with the bruised lemongrass, sliced ginger, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tbsp fish sauce for 15 minutes. Lift out the fish and flake it. Strain and keep the broth.

In a large pot, fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden. Add the garlic, grated ginger, chopped lemongrass, shrimp paste, paprika, chili flakes and the rest of the turmeric for 2 minutes.
Add the flaked fish and stir for 2 minutes. Pour in the broth.
Whisk the toasted rice flour and chickpea flour with a cup of water until smooth, then stir into the pot. Add the shallots and banana stem.
Simmer 30 minutes, stirring often, until thickened and the shallots are soft. Season with the remaining fish sauce.
Put noodles in each bowl, ladle the soup over and top with egg, cilantro, lime, chili and crunchy fritters or fried onions.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Toast the rice flour and chickpea flour until nutty and golden; this gives the broth its body and flavor.
Whisk the flours into cold water before adding them, so the soup stays smooth.
The crunchy toppings matter as much as the soup. Don't skip the fritters or fried onions.
recipe.make_ahead: The broth keeps 3 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen. Cook the noodles fresh.
variations: Use canned mackerel or sardines, a favorite shortcut in Burmese homes abroad.

vegetarian.title: Vegetarian Mohinga

rice flour, toasted in a dry pan until golden
chickpea flour, toasted in a dry pan until golden
small shallots, peeled and left whole
sliced banana stem or banana blossom (optional)
cilantro, lime wedges, chili flakes, fried onions and split pea fritters, to serve

Add the mushrooms and stir for 4 minutes. Pour in the broth.

vegetarian.make_ahead: The broth keeps 3 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen. Cook the noodles fresh.

small shallots, peeled and left whole

cilantro, lime wedges, chili flakes, fried onions and split pea fritters, to serve

recipe.title: Mojito
recipe.description: The Cuban highball: fresh mint gently pressed with lime and sugar, white rum and crushed ice, topped with soda. Bright and cooling.

ingredients.item: simple syrup (equal parts sugar and water)
fresh mint leaves, plus a big sprig to garnish

steps: Put the mint leaves and simple syrup in a highball glass. Press the mint gently with a muddler 4 or 5 times, just enough to bruise it and release its smell. Don't shred it.
Add the lime juice and rum, then fill the glass two-thirds with crushed ice.
Stir with a bar spoon, lifting from the bottom, for about 10 seconds so the mint rises through the ice.
Pile on more crushed ice, then top with soda water.
Slap the mint sprig between your hands to wake up its oils, then tuck it in next to a short straw so you smell it with every sip.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Leave out the rum, add 1/2 oz more lime and top with extra soda or ginger ale.

recipe.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.
tips: Muddle lightly. Shredded mint releases bitter, grassy flavors and leaves bits stuck in your teeth.
Crushed ice chills fast and dilutes just enough. To make it, wrap cubes in a clean towel and whack them with a rolling pin.
Simple syrup dissolves instantly. Granulated sugar stays gritty in cold drinks.
recipe.make_ahead: Make it to order. For a crowd, muddle mint, lime and syrup in a pitcher up to 1 hour ahead, add the rum, and add the ice and soda right before pouring.
variations: Strawberry or watermelon mojito: muddle 3 strawberries or a few watermelon cubes with the mint.
Use aged rum for a richer, caramel flavor.
Less sweet: cut the syrup to 1/2 oz.

recipe.title: Mole Poblano
recipe.description: Chicken in Puebla's rich, dark sauce of dried chiles, spices, nuts and chocolate.

ingredients.item: sesame seeds, plus more to serve

steps: Simmer the chicken in salted water until cooked, about 40 minutes. Keep the broth.
Toast the chiles briefly and soak in hot water 20 minutes.
Toast the almonds, sesame seeds, raisins, tortilla and bread in a little oil.
Blend everything except the chicken and chocolate with broth until very smooth.
Fry the sauce in oil for 10 minutes, add the chocolate and more broth and simmer 30 minutes until thick.
Add the chicken to warm through and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

recipe.title: Momos (Himalayan Dumplings)
recipe.description: Juicy steamed dumplings from Nepal and Tibet, filled with spiced chicken, onion, ginger and cilantro, and served with a smoky roasted tomato and sesame achar.

ingredients.item: oil or melted butter, for the filling

steps: Mix the flour and water into a smooth, firm dough. Knead 5 minutes, cover and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the chicken, red onion, green onions, ginger, garlic, cilantro, cumin, coriander, turmeric, 1 tsp salt and oil. Chill while you make the achar.

Char the tomatoes and chilies in a dry pan or under the broiler until blackened in spots. Blend them with the toasted sesame, lime juice, timur, the rest of the salt and a little water into a thick sauce.
Roll the dough into a log, cut into 30 pieces and roll each into a thin 3 1/2-inch circle, thinner at the edges.
Put a spoon of filling in the center and pleat the edges together into a round purse, twisting the top to seal.
Steam on oiled racks for 10 to 12 minutes, until the wrappers are glossy and the filling is cooked through (165°F). Serve hot with the achar.
recipe.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Roll the wrapper edges thinner than the center, so the pleated top isn't doughy.
The oil in the filling and the juice from the onion make the momos burst with broth when you bite them.
Charring the tomatoes gives the achar its smoky depth; don't skip it.
recipe.make_ahead: Freeze shaped momos on a tray, then bag them; steam from frozen for 15 minutes. The achar keeps 5 days.
variations: Jhol momo: thin the achar with hot broth and serve the momos in it as a soup.
Kothey momo: pan-fry the bottoms in oil after steaming until crisp.

vegetarian.title: Vegetable Momos
vegetarian.description: Steamed dumplings filled with cabbage, carrot, tofu and ginger, with the same smoky tomato and sesame achar.

ingredients.item: finely chopped cabbage, salted 10 minutes and squeezed dry, plus 1 grated carrot and 7 oz crumbled firm tofu

steps: Mix the flour and water into a smooth, firm dough. Knead 5 minutes, cover and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the cabbage, carrot, tofu, red onion, green onions, ginger, garlic, cilantro, cumin, coriander, turmeric, 1 tsp salt and oil. Chill while you make the achar.

Char the tomatoes and chilies in a dry pan or under the broiler until blackened in spots. Blend them with the toasted sesame, lime juice, timur, the rest of the salt and a little water into a thick sauce.
Roll the dough into a log, cut into 30 pieces and roll each into a thin 3 1/2-inch circle, thinner at the edges.
Put a spoon of filling in the center and pleat the edges together into a round purse, twisting the top to seal.
Steam on oiled racks for 10 to 12 minutes, until the wrappers are glossy and tender (165°F). Serve hot with the achar.
vegetarian.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.
tips: Roll the wrapper edges thinner than the center, so the pleated top isn't doughy.
Squeeze the salted cabbage well, or the filling will turn watery and tear the wrappers.
Charring the tomatoes gives the achar its smoky depth; don't skip it.
vegetarian.make_ahead: Freeze shaped momos on a tray, then bag them; steam from frozen for 15 minutes. The achar keeps 5 days.
